name: ghanemja.github.io
description: Static project index — grid of every site I run, with live screenshots embedded as thumbnails.
howItWorks: Single index.html + screenshots dir; cards link out to deployed apps.
moat: Zero-build, refreshes automatically. No CMS to maintain.
whenToUse: Quick scrollable overview of every project at a glance.
future: Auto-import from GitHub API, tag filters, deploy-status badges.

name: ghanemja
description: GitHub profile README — landing card for visitors hitting my profile.
howItWorks: Single Markdown file rendered by GitHub on profile page.
moat: Personal first impression, links to active projects.
whenToUse: What people see before clicking into any repo.
future: Recent-activity feed, animated stats, pinned demos.

name: crochet
description: Niche social app for crochet patterns + threads — share, fork, remix.
howItWorks: Users post patterns, others reply in threads or spin off variants.
moat: Hobby-specific UX beats generic forums or Pinterest.
whenToUse: Posting/discovering crochet patterns; tracking your own queue.
future: Per-niche hobbymaxxing platform — DJ/music, knitting, brewing, etc.

name: pptgpt
description: Prompt-to-PowerPoint generator with template-aware styling.
howItWorks: Prompt → LLM outline → pptx-template-styler renders branded slides.
moat: Template fidelity (logo, fonts, layout) — most AI-deck tools lose brand.
whenToUse: Drafting decks from prompts; iterating on existing slide content.
future: Split-screen design/result view, 3blue1brown-style math visuals, interactive plot manipulation.

name: inbox-zero-board
description: Kanban-style inbox — drag emails between columns (todo / waiting / done).
howItWorks: Pulls from email API, renders as draggable cards, syncs status back.
moat: Visual triage replaces the linear scroll-and-archive ritual.
whenToUse: When email backlog is overwhelming and you need structure.
future: LLM auto-categorization, snooze suggestions, shared team boards.

name: charterscope
description: Charter-party analysis — flags unusual clauses in maritime shipping contracts.
howItWorks: Upload PDF, NLP extracts clauses, scored against market-baseline embeddings.
moat: Domain-specific clause embeddings tuned on maritime corpus.
whenToUse: Reviewing or negotiating a charter party before signing.
future: Multi-language, broker-network integration, redline suggestions.

name: agentsannonymous
description: Multi-agent sandbox — specialist agents debate w/ retrieval grounding, SMEs score outputs.
howItWorks: Agents take roles, debate w/ citations; SME feedback flows into RL re-ranker that strengthens wiki/KG connections.
moat: HITL learning loop tied to knowledge-graph strengthening, not just chat history.
whenToUse: Open-ended domain problems where expert oversight matters.
future: Brainchamp pivot to healthcare/legal verticals; citation-penalty agent; agent-lifespan RL.

name: cadme
description: CAD dataset + model — generates parametric, editable CAD from reference geometry.
howItWorks: Mesh / image → trained model outputs CadQuery sequence-of-operations.
moat: Editable parametric output, not just static mesh — preserves design intent.
whenToUse: Reverse-engineering reference parts into modifiable CAD.
future: Assembly support, sketch+constraint tier, hybrid AI + RANSAC pipeline.

name: stencil
description: Stencil-pattern utility — generate cuttable stencil files from images.
howItWorks: Image → edge detection + threshold → SVG/DXF stencil output.
moat: Cut-friendly islands (no floating disconnected pieces).
whenToUse: Vinyl/laser-cutter prep from any source image.
future: Multi-color layered stencils, AI-guided detail simplification.

name: caddy
description: CAD tooling layer — shared utilities for the cadme/caddy-query stack.
howItWorks: Geometry helpers, BRep adapters, dataset loaders for CAD experiments.
moat: Shared substrate avoids reinventing CAD primitives per project.
whenToUse: Building any CAD-adjacent tool in the stack.
future: Spin out as standalone Python package.

name: cadme-10k
description: 10k-scale parametric CAD dataset — sequences-of-operations per part.
howItWorks: Curated/generated CadQuery scripts paired w/ rendered meshes + STEP exports.
moat: Unifies geometry-only, sketch+constraint, sequence/construction-history tiers in one dataset.
whenToUse: Training CAD-generative models that need editable output.
future: Assembly-level expansion (mate constraints, assembly trees); million-scale variant.

name: brain-university
description: Personalized curriculum builder — turns paper corpora into adaptive video lessons.
howItWorks: Topic → RAG over arXiv + local corpus → rerank → extract claims → render interactive lesson + 30s video summary.
moat: Time-evolving wiki where LLM makes and breaks connections as understanding grows.
whenToUse: Onboarding into a new technical domain or paper cluster.
future: 3blue1brown-style visuals, plain-English Hebbian/RL metric overlays, NotebookLM-style podcasts, MathMotion videos.

name: caddy-query
description: CAD natural-language query layer — ask questions about CAD parts in plain English.
howItWorks: Parses CAD metadata + geometry features, exposes searchable index for LLM-grounded answers.
moat: Geometry-aware retrieval, not just metadata search.
whenToUse: Navigating large CAD libraries or part catalogs.
future: Multi-modal queries (sketch + text), assembly-tree reasoning.

name: beanbots
description: Experimental tiny agents — exploring lightweight specialist behaviors.
howItWorks: Small specialized agents w/ minimal context, coordinated via shared scratchpad.
moat: Tiny footprint, CPU-runnable target.
whenToUse: Latency-sensitive tasks or constrained-compute environments.
future: Distill into single brain-like CPU model w/ same effective behavior.

name: sketchy
description: Sketch-to-CAD experiment — hand-drawn input → parametric primitives.
howItWorks: Stroke segmentation → shape recognition → CadQuery primitive emission.
moat: Bridges informal sketch input to formal CAD output.
whenToUse: Early ideation when full CAD UI is too heavy.
future: Napkin-to-CAD pipeline (hand sketch → engineering part).

name: cq_dataset
description: CadQuery script dataset — labeled training corpus for CAD-generative models.
howItWorks: Scraped/curated CadQuery scripts with rendered preview + STEP file pairs.
moat: Code-level dataset (not just mesh), enables sequence-modeling approaches.
whenToUse: Pretraining or fine-tuning CAD-generative models.
future: Scale toward cadme-10k targets, add assembly-level samples.

name: RL_Tutorial
description: Hands-on reinforcement-learning tutorial — notebooks walking through core algorithms.
howItWorks: Jupyter notebooks: Q-learning → policy gradient → actor-critic, each w/ minimal env.
moat: Single-file runnable, no framework lock-in.
whenToUse: Self-study or teaching RL fundamentals.
future: Add modern PPO/SAC, 3b1b-style intuition diagrams.

name: maze
description: Maze generator + solver playground.
howItWorks: Procedural maze generation (DFS / Prim's), pathfinding visualizations on top.
moat: Quick sandbox for prototyping search algorithms.
whenToUse: Testing pathfinding ideas or generating maze content.
future: 3D mazes, RL agent that learns to navigate.

name: html
description: HTML sketches — small static experiments, throwaway prototypes.
howItWorks: Each subfolder = one self-contained HTML demo.
moat: Zero-dependency, instant deploy.
whenToUse: Quick UX or layout experiments before bigger investment.
future: Promote standouts into proper repos.

name: ros2_depth_camera_tutorial
description: ROS2 depth-camera walkthrough — from raw stream to usable point clouds.
howItWorks: Step-by-step nodes: camera bringup → calibration → depth-to-pointcloud → visualization.
moat: Single-doc end-to-end (most tutorials cover one slice only).
whenToUse: Onboarding a new depth-camera setup into a ROS2 stack.
future: Add Intel RealSense + Orbbec variants, AI-stitch tutorial.

name: jobapp
description: Personal job-application tracker.
howItWorks: Track applications, status, follow-up dates, notes per company.
moat: Built for my workflow — no SaaS pricing, full data control.
whenToUse: Actively job-hunting across many companies.
future: Resume-version tracking per app, auto-pull job postings.

name: qnx_materials
description: QNX RTOS learning materials — notes, examples, exercises.
howItWorks: Curated docs + working example code for QNX Neutrino.
moat: Hands-on QNX content is rare on the public web.
whenToUse: Coming up to speed on QNX for safety-critical robotics work.
future: Add automotive ECU-targeted examples, real-time scheduling deep-dives.

name: project
description: Scratch repo — placeholder for in-flight experiments.
howItWorks: Whatever I'm prototyping; gets renamed once it crystallizes.
moat: n/a (scratch space)
whenToUse: Spinning up something new before naming.
future: Most contents migrate to dedicated repos.

name: fitter
description: Curve / primitive fitting experiment — fit shapes to point data.
howItWorks: RANSAC + least-squares pipelines for line/circle/plane/spline fits.
moat: Classical robust-fit baselines before reaching for ML.
whenToUse: Geometric estimation from noisy data.
future: Wrap as a service consumed by cadme + sketchy.

name: AnimalFinder
description: Image classifier for animal species.
howItWorks: Fine-tuned CNN on a labeled animal dataset; web demo with confidence scores.
moat: Lightweight, runs in-browser via ONNX or TFJS.
whenToUse: Quick species ID from a photo.
future: Region/habitat metadata, citizen-science data export.

name: computer_vision
description: Computer-vision notebooks — coursework + experiments.
howItWorks: Classic + modern CV pipelines: filters, features, detection, segmentation.
moat: Reference implementations side-by-side for learning.
whenToUse: Refreshing CV fundamentals or comparing approaches.
future: Add depth-estimation, 3D-reconstruction notebooks.

name: autonomy
description: Autonomy coursework — perception → planning → control stack.
howItWorks: Modular ROS nodes for each layer; simulated environment for end-to-end tests.
moat: Full stack in one repo (most coursework covers one layer).
whenToUse: Studying full autonomy pipelines.
future: Swap simulator for hardware, add learned-policy planner.

name: autonomous_machines
description: Coursework on autonomous-machine fundamentals.
howItWorks: Lecture notes + Python implementations of core algorithms (Kalman, A*, MPC).
moat: Bridges theory + runnable code.
whenToUse: Studying or teaching autonomous-systems fundamentals.
future: Add modern learning-based controllers.

name: role-radar
description: Role-discovery prototype — surfaces fit between candidate skills and open roles.
howItWorks: Embeds resumes + job posts, scores fit, ranks candidate roles.
moat: Embedding-based vs keyword-based ATS matching.
whenToUse: Job seekers narrowing their target list; hiring teams shortlisting.
future: Bidirectional matching, transparency on which signals drove the score.

name: portfolio
description: Original portfolio site (pre-bookshelf).
howItWorks: Static HTML/CSS, project cards link out to demos.
moat: First version; superseded by the 3D bookshelf this site lives in.
whenToUse: Reference for old layout or older project descriptions.
future: Archive; bookshelf-portfolio is the new home.

name: neovert
description: Neovim config / utility plugin.
howItWorks: Lua config + supporting helpers for a personalized Neovim setup.
moat: Tuned to my exact workflow.
whenToUse: Bootstrapping a new machine with my editor setup.
future: Extract reusable bits into community-friendly plugin.

name: deepracer-analysis
description: AWS DeepRacer training-log analysis tooling.
howItWorks: Parses race logs, plots reward shaping vs lap-time tradeoffs.
moat: Reveals reward-hacking patterns most dashboards miss.
whenToUse: Tuning DeepRacer reward functions.
future: Compare across cars, suggest reward-fn tweaks.

name: hackathon2022
description: 2022 hackathon submission.
howItWorks: Weekend prototype — details in repo README.
moat: Built fast under time pressure.
whenToUse: Reference for the problem space tackled that weekend.

howItWorks: Ingests dataset → models as graph → Cypher queries surface patterns.
moat: Graph-shaped problem solved natively in Neo4j.
whenToUse: Reference for graph-modeling patterns.
future: Archive.

name: processchamp
description: Process-management utility.
howItWorks: Wraps OS process tools w/ a friendlier CLI for managing long-running jobs.
moat: Defaults tuned for ML/data-science workflows.
whenToUse: Babysitting long training runs.

name: OSDC22-XGBoost
description: Open Source Data Conference 2022 XGBoost talk materials.
howItWorks: Notebook + slides walking through gradient-boosted tree intuition.
moat: Conference-grade explanation with runnable code.

description: Undergraduate senior-design capstone project.
howItWorks: Multi-quarter team build; details in repo README.

whenToUse: Reference for the engineering problem tackled.
